[Review Number 484] I play some Permafrost (early access) and give my opinion throughout, along with a fellow streamer in my party (twitch.tv/captainbean)... skip to the end if you just want the review summary. How does the game compare to similar 3rd person survival crafting games like Green Hell, Grounded or Stranded Deep? Is it worth buying or playing $25?

You can support the channel at http://patreon.com/LFP or https://streamelements.com/lfpgaming/tip and you can also buy Steam games DIRECTLY from developers at https://www.nexus.gg/lfpgaming

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254990/Permafrost/

PC Specs: Nvidia RTX 5080 GPU with AMD Ryzen 5 5700X3D CPU and 64GB DDR4 RAM

0:19 Start
2:18 Gameplay
2:17:25 Verdict

Steam description: "Permafrost is a story-driven survival sandbox set in a frozen, post-apocalyptic world. Discover a vast lore-rich open world, alone or in co-op with up to 4 players. Explore, scavenge, craft, and build a network of shelters to outlast the cold."

#Permafrost #firstimpression #firstimpressions #game #indie #indiegame #indiedev #indiegamedev #survival #survivalgame #openworld #openworldcrafting #crafting
